phases.goal: Move the red block into the left rank position.
phases.name: place_red_left
phases.verify: Red block is leftmost or on a recoverable path to leftmost.

phases.goal: Move the green block next to red without disturbing red.
phases.name: place_green_middle
phases.verify: Red remains left of green and both remain stable.

phases.goal: Move the blue block to the right side of the red-green pair.
phases.name: place_blue_right
phases.verify: Visible order is red, green, blue from left to right.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse historical coordinates.
critical_gates: Red is placed before green is finalized.
Green is placed while preserving red.
Blue is placed while preserving the red-green relation.

roles.manipulated_order: red block, then green block, then blue block
roles.protected: already placed blocks stay stable while the next color moves

task_language: Position red block, green block, and blue block from left to right in the specified sequence.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 4:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 5:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 6:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 7:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 8:move_to(arm=left,gripper=keep,orientation=keep); 9:move_to(arm=left,gripper=keep,orientation=keep); 10:move_to(arm=left,gripper=keep,orientation=keep); 11:release(arm=left). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid transporting blue after a close alone; verify blue lifts with the gripper and preserve the red-green order before placing it to the right.
